developing a new generation of high-power, high-efficiency, and high-bandwidth monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMICs) based on gallium-nitride (GaN), a wide-bandgap semiconductor material.
the development of high power, wide-bandwidth GaN MMIC amplifiers operating in W-band (75–110 GHz).
the design and fabrication of high power GaN MMIC amplifiers operating at millimeter wave frequencies.
